messages:
sam: FYI getting a flood of 500s from hosted inference since the 09:10 deploy. Support tickets from 3 customers reporting timeouts + 5xx for text.generate endpoints.
jen: Ugh. Any common denominator? model, route, or region?
sam: All are using the default /v1/generate route on hosted with model redwood-large. Errors look like backend gateway 502/504 or timeout.
kevin: Pinging logs now. I see a spike in gateway errors starting at 09:12. Canary was 09:10.
anna (oncall): Can we confirm if any config flags changed in the rollout? especially auth or proxy headers.
kevin: Checking rollout metadata... config flag set: "auth_header_strip=true" on the canary group. That wasn't in the previous stable.
sam: Support attached a curl repro that fails consistently: 
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```
jen: Does the auth proxy expect a different header after the change? Could be the strip flag removing required header for some customers.
kevin: Logs from the ingress show missing Authorization header for downstream services after that flag. Upstream returns 401 which turns into 502 at the gateway for some tenants. Sample log: 
```
INGRESS: req_id=abc123 route=/v1/generate auth_header_present=false upstream_status=401 -> gateway=502
```
ops-oncall: If that's true, we need to rollback the flag. Rolling back canary config now.
deploy-bot: rollback initiated for deployment id deploy-2024-09-10-0910, scope=canary. Reason: auth_header_strip caused downstream auth failures.
jen: I'll update support and triage the highest-severity tickets with the rollback note. Please include repro and timeframe.
kevin: Rollback completed — deploy-bot reports stable config restored at 09:18. Monitoring for error rate.
anna (oncall): Seeing error rate drop in the next 3 minutes. Latency returning to baseline.
sam: Support notified customers and escalations de-escalated. They asked for root cause writeup and mitigation plan.
kevin: Short-term action: revert flag in rollout pipeline + add a preflight check that verifies downstream header passes.
jen: I'll file follow-up ticket with customer-facing summary. Assigning to kevin for the postmortem and to platform team for the preflight. @kevin @anna (oncall)
ops-oncall: Marking incident resolved for now — keep an eye on late reports. :white_check_mark:
